title: Gitmap color record (one line of colors.ndjson)
description: One palette colour: {id, name, rgb, cmyk?, opacity?}. colors.ndjson line order is the stacking order (first line = topmost); no stacking index or colour number is stored, and an OCD/OMap writer numbers colours by line position.

id.description: Stable id: color_<slug(name)> (color_unnamed when the slug is empty). In stacking order, the topmost colour of each slug keeps the bare id; each other colour takes the lowest _N (N >= 2) not used by any other colour id. Symbols reference this, never a number.

rgb.description: Screen colour as an [r, g, b] integer triple (0..255), matching cmyk's array shape.

cmyk.description: Print/OCAD ink [c,m,y,k], each 0..1, snapped to OCAD's whole-percent (2 dp) grid.
